'''Bernardino Gaetano Scorza''' (29 September 1876, in [[Morano Calabro]] – 6 August 1939, in [[Rome]]) was an Italian mathematician working in [[algebraic geometry]], whose work inspired the theory of [[Scorza varieties]].
